narrations.title: The Boastful Lion
narrations.narration: Leo the lion strutted through the jungle, puffing out his chest with an air of self-importance. Nearby, Rosie the rabbit watched him through her yellow glasses, tapping her chin as she noted his overconfidence.

narrations.title: The Clever Plan
narrations.narration: Rosie approached Leo with a twinkle in her eye. She spun around excitedly and whispered a rumor about a rival lion who claimed to be the smartest in the jungle.

narrations.title: The March to the Well
narrations.narration: Determined to protect his reputation, Leo marched toward the well with dramatic, wide arm movements. Rosie hopped quickly beside him, her long ears bouncing in the breeze.

narrations.title: The Mystery Rival
narrations.narration: They reached the ancient, mossy stone well. Rosie pointed down into the dark water, where Leo saw a lion staring back at him.

narrations.title: The Big Splash
narrations.narration: Leo roared with all his might, but the reflection only mocked him. Fed up, Leo leaped into the well, only to land with a giant, soaking splash.

narrations.title: A Soggy Lesson
narrations.narration: Soaking wet and feeling less like a king, Leo climbed out. Rosie giggled softly and adjusted her glasses, revealing the truth of the mystery.

narrations.title: Wisdom Earned
narrations.narration: Leo sighed, his pride washed away by the well water. He finally understood that being truly smart meant observing the world, not just shouting about himself.
